content:
❌ Rejected the contribution.
Comment: Dozens of issues raised aren't addressed, the main ones being:
* Inadequate case coverage
* Wrong case numbering
* Badly formatted statement

Formatting
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below.

Goal
* Please remove "## The Vault of Whispers
### Goal".

* Please use the correct syntax to format variables and bold text.

* Please format "-1" as a {{constant}}.

* Please add "in some cases" after "large enough".

Input
* Please delete "input".

* Please format "Line 1", "Line 2" and "Line 3" in <<bold>>.

* Please format all [[variables]].

Output
* Please delete "Output".

* Please format "One line" in <<bold>>

* Please change "-" to "{{-1}}".

Constraints
* Please format all [[variables]].

Difficulty
* Please lower the difficulty from Very Hard to Hard. This puzzle is at most Hard (or towards the higher end of Medium). Although some optimisation is required, the underlying concept isn't complex enough to justify a Very Hard rating.

Cases
* The following input and output ranges are currently missing from the test suite:
  • N: 6 to 39
  • fragment value: integers with 3 to 14 digits
  • T: integers with 3 to 14 digits
  • Output: greater than 2

  In particular, the gap between the first 3 pairs of cases and the final pair is too large. Please add new pairs of cases to cover these missing ranges as much as possible.

* Please use random values in the cases as much as possible.

* Each test and its validator should cover the same scenario. Currently, none of the tests matches its validator:

  • Test 1: Simple case, normal scenario

  • Validator 1: Single-element list, target = that element

  • Test 2: Single-element list, target ≠ that element

  • Validator 2: List doesn't contain 0, target = 0

  • Test 3: Duplicate values in list

  • Validator 3: Entire list is required to reach target

  • Test 6: Large random numbers, unreachable target

  • Validator 6: Every fragment has the same value, target = that value

  Please make each test and its validator cover the same scenario, resulting in 8 matching pairs before adding the additional scenarios below.

* Please add one test/validator pair for each of the following scenarios:

  • The list contains a few 0s and a few duplicated non-zero values, and target = 0.

  • The list contains no duplicate values, and many different subsets of varying sizes reach a non-zero target.

  • 11 ≤ N ≤ 20 and Output > 5.

  • 21 ≤ N ≤ 30 and Output > 10.

  • 31 ≤ N ≤ 40 and N - 5 ≤ Output ≤ N.

  • N = Output = 40.

* After adding these new scenarios, there should be 14 test/validator pairs in total. You're welcome to add more if they cover additional scenarios or improve coverage of the input ranges.

* Once the cases have been updated, please ensure they're numbered correctly and ordered in ascending order of difficulty. The current Test 1 should remain as Test 1.

Thanks.
